The replay is fixture coverage, not full-subject regrading of other document dialects. See docs/assessments/2026-10-26-iac-docxref-impact.md.

L2: the oracle's references are every reference a definition makes to a definition of its own module, keyed by the referring file wherever the target is declared and named by address (module.m.o names the call module.m), as lang-oracle compares Calls. ref_recall 1.0; ref_precision .9866: the 57 references fathom draws beyond the tool (9 vpc, 48 eks) were each checked to be written in their definition's source, in the oracle's two blind spots: a local value's (36), read from the plan graph, and a dynamic block's content (21), which the configuration JSON does not render and the plan graph keeps only when no other reference of the same definition already depends on the target (OpenTofu transitively reduces the graph): vpc's local.vpc_id -> aws_vpc.this, eks's aws_eks_cluster.this -> var.encryption_config.

L3 limits: the repaired engine emits 13 cross-file pairs beyond the native set. Historical adjudication: the 13 beyond the tool are the L2 blind spots, a local or a data source's dynamic block referring to variables.tf. This rerun did not individually re-adjudicate them. The native oracle scores file-granularity destinations, not typed attribute binding. The recovered 1381 pairs show the repair's measured effect; this aggregate result does not itself classify every historical miss by cause. Registry, remote, escaping, caller-directory and nonliteral module sources remain outside the repaired two-hop strategy.

L3: baseline 6db920e72: EKS 651/866, VPC 1496/2662, total 2147/3528, recall 0.6086, precision 0.9940; repaired df20b1f1810c96dde9c00d919166f44746376993: EKS 866/866, VPC 2662/2662, total 3528/3528, recall 1.0000, precision 0.9963. The original clean baseline ran three times, and the clean landing engine ran three times against the same raw native truth and full 87-file/523029-byte and 77-file/453543-byte measured sets. Counts, metrics and grades agreed within each set of runs. The reading uses the landing engine's median CPU-throughput run. L1 and L2 grades are excellent and excellent, respectively.

Native oracle: OpenTofu 1.13.0 show -json -config and graph -type=plan on every .tf directory (19 roots per subject), after init -backend=false -get=false. Preparation checks scratch .tf paths and bytes, strips all cached local records, and preseeds exact registry pins. Plain native init installs local entries; bounded retries retain native locals and restore only missing pinned registry descendants. Every native local key and source agrees with the separate scanner proposal; subject-local destinations agree lexically. Physical checkout paths for local children under registry modules pass only when their resolved target equals the pinned cache alias, with a separate alias count in the receipt. Native Dir values are never rewritten. All roots succeeded. Positions come from an independent line reader: 0 definitions unlocated, range_agreement 1.0 across 3,111 definitions. Registry module files are outside the measured subject. Providers came only from a private filesystem mirror; no plan, apply or cloud API was run. AWS 6.67.0 was identified previously; seven ancillary provider versions and ten registry module versions are newly pinned compatible inputs. See docs/assessments/data/terraform-two-hop-2026-10-26/summary.json.

Timing: landing-engine CPU-throughput median 8.04 MB/s from three runs on a shared Apple Silicon helper, Go 1.27.3, nice 10, GOMAXPROCS=2, GOFLAGS=-p=2. The 1-minute load at each launch was 5.7026; concurrent jobs were not recorded. The original baseline median was 8.53 MB/s under a load guard <=9, but its per-run load and concurrent jobs were not recorded. Wall extract_ms is not comparable, and this reading makes no extraction-cost regression claim.

names are compared whole (name_match identity): a terraform address carries dots (aws_vpc.this, data.T.N, module.m, var.x, local.x, output.o), so the last-segment rule would conflate every resource named `this`. Local values are measured (canonical variable) now that the oracle is the tool: universal-ctags 6.2.1's spurious nested-map `local` tags were why the earlier tier-B reading excluded them. Providers have no canonical kind and are excluded.
